melies.count_note: 380 technique names transcribed from the index page fetch (2026-10-25); the site describes the page as 400+ techniques, so the transcribed set is a near-complete index, not a claim of all 400+. No thumbnails or example videos copied.

one_movement_rule: One shot, one camera movement. Lighting, atmosphere and composition choices are layers and may stack; camera movements may not. This holds even where a source site suggests combining 2-3 techniques in one prompt: combine layers, never two movements.

vvsvs.note_zh: 从高处俯瞰大地，交代规模与方位，人物在环境面前显得渺小。
vvsvs.prompt_fragment_en: high aerial view of [Subject], vast landscape, small human scale

vvsvs.note_zh: 镜头直对地面向下看，平面化构图，图案与排列本身成为看点。
vvsvs.prompt_fragment_en: direct top-down view of [Subject], flattened pattern, long shadows

vvsvs.note_zh: 地平线故意倾斜，画面立刻带上不安与失衡感。
vvsvs.prompt_fragment_en: tilted horizon, diagonal lines across [Subject], uneasy framing

vvsvs.note_zh: 整机沿轨道平滑移动，空间感真实，适合带观众走进场景。
vvsvs.prompt_fragment_en: smooth dolly move toward [Subject], steady parallax between layers

vvsvs.note_zh: 从下往上看，人物显得高大、有压迫感或具英雄气。
vvsvs.prompt_fragment_en: low angle looking up at [Subject], towering verticals, strong presence

vvsvs.note_zh: 从上往下看，人物显得弱小、受困或被环境包围。
vvsvs.prompt_fragment_en: high angle looking down on [Subject], small against the surroundings

vvsvs.note_zh: 从一人肩后看向另一人，对话的空间关系与张力一次交代。
vvsvs.prompt_fragment_en: over-the-shoulder framing, near shoulder soft in foreground, [Subject] sharp beyond

vvsvs.note_zh: 同一镜内焦点从前景滑向背景（或反向），不切镜就转移注意力。
vvsvs.prompt_fragment_en: focus pulls from foreground detail to [Subject] in background, soft bokeh plane

vvsvs.note_zh: 机位移动与变焦反向同步，主体大小不变而背景伸缩，眩晕感极强。
vvsvs.prompt_fragment_en: dolly-zoom on [Subject], subject size locked, background warping

vvsvs.note_zh: 摇臂带镜头大范围升降或横移，揭示场面规模，仪式感强。
vvsvs.prompt_fragment_en: crane move rising over [Subject], scale of the place revealed gradually

vvsvs.note_zh: 时间被拉长，细节与情绪重量被放大，适合关键一瞬。
vvsvs.prompt_fragment_en: slow motion of [Subject], suspended detail, dust hanging in light

vvsvs.note_zh: 穿戴稳定器跟随人物穿行复杂空间，漂浮感平滑而自由。
vvsvs.prompt_fragment_en: steadicam gliding with [Subject] through the space, floating smooth motion

vvsvs.note_zh: 主光、补光、轮廓光各司其职，是最稳妥的人像布光起点。
vvsvs.prompt_fragment_en: three-point lighting on [Subject], key, soft fill, rim separation

vvsvs.note_zh: 大面积暗部、少量亮部，对比强烈，悬疑与压抑感直接拉满。
vvsvs.prompt_fragment_en: low-key lighting on [Subject], deep shadows, single hard accent

vvsvs.note_zh: 强烈的明暗交界，带油画感，适合庄重或道德对峙的场面。
vvsvs.prompt_fragment_en: chiaroscuro on [Subject], deep shadow against sculpted highlight

vvsvs.note_zh: 暗侧脸颊上留一小块三角亮斑，人像立刻显得贵而立体。
vvsvs.prompt_fragment_en: Rembrandt lighting on [Subject], small triangle of light on the shadowed cheek

vvsvs.note_zh: 主体全暗、只剩轮廓，形状与姿态本身讲故事。
vvsvs.prompt_fragment_en: silhouette of [Subject] against bright sky, pure dark shape, clean outline

vvsvs.note_zh: 日出日落前后的暖金色低角度光，万物自带温情滤镜。
vvsvs.prompt_fragment_en: golden hour light on [Subject], warm amber, long soft shadows

vvsvs.note_zh: 天光将尽未尽的深蓝时段，配几点暖光，孤独与宁静并存。
vvsvs.prompt_fragment_en: blue hour over [Subject], deep indigo sky, few warm lights within

vvsvs.note_zh: 画面里的灯、烛、窗本身就是光源，光有来处，真实感强。
vvsvs.prompt_fragment_en: practical lights visible in frame, [Subject] lit by lamps and windows in scene

vvsvs.note_zh: 主体落在三分线交点附近，画面立刻显得经过设计而不呆板。
vvsvs.prompt_fragment_en: [Subject] placed on a third-line intersection, balanced off-center framing

vvsvs.note_zh: 左右严格对称，秩序感与仪式感极强，稍有打破就成看点。
vvsvs.prompt_fragment_en: perfectly symmetrical framing of [Subject], centered, mirrored balance

vvsvs.note_zh: 路、墙、光带等线条把视线引向主体，纵深一次建立。
vvsvs.prompt_fragment_en: leading lines drawing the eye to [Subject], depth built by converging lines

vvsvs.note_zh: 大面积空旷包围小主体，孤独、等待或压迫感不言自明。
vvsvs.prompt_fragment_en: vast negative space around [Subject], small figure, quiet emptiness

vvsvs.note_zh: 前景、中景、远景同时清晰，观众自己在画面里找信息。
vvsvs.prompt_fragment_en: deep focus on [Subject], foreground to background all sharp

vvsvs.note_zh: 只有主体清晰、其余化开，视线无处可逃，只能看向主体。
vvsvs.prompt_fragment_en: shallow focus on [Subject], background dissolving into soft bokeh

vvsvs.note_zh: 两条线交替出现，观众自动把它们拼成同一时间的对照。
vvsvs.prompt_fragment_en: cross-cut rhythm between [Subject] and the parallel action

vvsvs.note_zh: 一镜渐隐、下一镜渐显，时间流逝与记忆过渡最温和的办法。
vvsvs.prompt_fragment_en: dissolve transition from [Subject] to the next scene, time passing gently

vvsvs.note_zh: 短镜组接成一段，压缩时间、并置意义，节奏由剪辑定。
vvsvs.prompt_fragment_en: montage of [Subject] in brief shots, compressed time, rhythmic cuts

vvsvs.note_zh: 低调光、雨夜、斜线阴影，道德灰色地带的气质一次到位。
vvsvs.prompt_fragment_en: film noir mood for [Subject], low-key light, rain sheen, slanted shadows

vvsvs_note: 30 core techniques selected across the site's categories (Camera Work 12 / Lighting 8 / Composition 6 / Editing 3 / Genres & Styles 1). Notes and prompt fragments are hevi's own one-line rewrites; the site's long descriptions and full templates were NOT copied. Source links point to the library index page (per-technique detail slugs were not extracted).
